purpose: PR152 canonical participation, accounting, seeded sanity, same-seed replay, observer parity and matched performance evidence

sourceStability.reason: App-only observer reset correction; the panel is never imported by the headless driver; all core/engine/runner files remain byte-identical

collection.correctnessTimings: contended; excluded from performance claims; no raw contended duration is included in these normalized rows
collection.isolatedTimings: one benchmark process, same hardware, same driver, matched CM 45-minute seeds a/b; no test processes

definitions.possessionEpisode: one canonical control episode; receive-control-carry-dribble-release is one episode
definitions.hiddenInvolvement: canonical statistic deltas while footage is hidden; possession starts are attributed once and do not change when visibility changes
definitions.defensiveInvolvement: challenge attempts + interceptions + available loose-ball recoveries + blocks; tackle wins are a subset of attempts and are not added again
definitions.legacyDefense: before main lacks recovery/block/duel public counters; missing new components are null and hidden defensive coverage is explicitly partial
definitions.playerShares: controlled possession/pass attempts divided by own-team totals
definitions.rates: match rates use actual canonical seconds; player minutes stop at dismissal; second-yellow dismissal contributes two cautions plus one red to cards
definitions.warnings: conservative diagnostic flags, no gameplay quotas or corrective statistical tuning

limitations: Original human playtest seed/state was not supplied; the seven-touch half is not claimed reproduced.
Three balanced seeds, two weak-team seeds and two aggression-stress seeds provide deterministic regression evidence, not global empirical football calibration.
Contended matrix timing is excluded; isolated performance comparison has two matched 45-minute seeds and is not a broad latency distribution.
No statistical quota, foul-rate target, rendering expansion or PR153 visual continuity implementation is used.
